problem.h: The voice in your head isn’t always kind
p: You’d never talk to a friend the way you talk to yourself on a tough day. But when you’re tired and busy, the gentle reminders are the first thing to go.
Most sticker packs don’t help much either: half of them are duplicates, and the colours never go together.

approach.h: Put the kind words where you’ll actually see them
p: “Reminder: you matter.” “Note to self: you are doing the best you can.” A sticker on your laptop or bottle catches your eye a dozen times a day, without you having to remember anything.
Every one of the 50 designs is different, and they share one soft, matching palette, so they look calm together on a page.
